_about: PsychoPal literature search + scoring config (adapted from the Neurodynamics Digest). Each group: 'stream' (where its papers are shown), 'weight' (priority), 'query' (boolean string for PubMed + Europe PMC, and OpenAlex if openalex=true; 'pubmed'/'europepmc'/'openalex_query' override per source), 'keywords' (lowercase regexes re-checked on title/abstract of EVERY record, incl. bulk bioRxiv/medRxiv/arXiv), optional 'require_imaging', 'all_of', 'also_requires_re', 'anchored' (profile-anchored: kept only from anchor venues and if similar enough to Claudio's profile). {xxx_terms} placeholders expand from the top-level strings below. Edit freely; no code changes needed.
psychedelic_terms: (psychedelic OR psychedelics OR psilocybin OR psilocin OR LSD OR "lysergic acid diethylamide" OR DMT OR dimethyltryptamine OR "5-MeO-DMT" OR mebufotenin OR ayahuasca OR mescaline OR MDMA OR ibogaine OR "serotonergic hallucinogen" OR hallucinogen OR psychoplastogen)
imaging_terms: (EEG OR electroencephalography OR MEG OR magnetoencephalography OR fMRI OR "functional MRI" OR "functional magnetic resonance" OR neuroimaging OR PET OR "positron emission" OR "PET-MR" OR "brain imaging" OR "diffusion MRI" OR "event-related potential" OR "TMS-EEG")

groups.name: psychedelic_imaging
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms} AND {imaging_terms}

groups.name: psychedelic_any
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms}

groups.name: psychedelic_clinical
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms} AND (trial OR randomized OR randomised OR patients OR depression OR "treatment-resistant" OR "alcohol use disorder" OR addiction OR anorexia OR PTSD)

groups.name: preclinical_psychedelic
groups.query: {psychedelic_terms} AND (mice OR mouse OR rat OR rats OR rodent OR "in vitro" OR neurons OR zebrafish OR organoid)

groups.name: own_centre
groups.pubmed: "Centre for Psychedelic Research"[ad] OR "Center for Psychedelic Research"[ad] OR ("Imperial College"[ad] AND (psychedelic* OR psilocybin OR DMT OR LSD OR ketamine))
groups.europepmc: AFF:"Centre for Psychedelic Research" OR (AFF:"Imperial College" AND (psychedelic OR psilocybin OR DMT OR LSD OR ketamine))

groups.name: altered_states_nondrug
groups.query: (breathwork OR holotropic OR "connected breathing" OR meditation OR hypnosis OR "altered state of consciousness" OR "altered states of consciousness" OR dreamachine OR stroboscopic) AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR neuroimaging OR "brain dynamics" OR complexity)

groups.name: serotonin_pet
groups.query: (serotonin OR "5-HT" OR "5-HT2A" OR "5-HT1A" OR "5-HT1B" OR "5-HT4" OR SERT OR "serotonin transporter" OR "serotonin release" OR Cimbi) AND (PET OR "positron emission" OR radioligand OR "receptor occupancy" OR "binding potential")

groups.name: ketamine_rapid
groups.query: (ketamine OR esketamine OR arketamine OR "rapid-acting antidepressant" OR "rapid acting antidepressant" OR "nitrous oxide" OR zuranolone OR "NMDA receptor antagonist")

groups.name: plasticity
groups.query: (psychoplastogen OR "non-hallucinogenic" OR nonhallucinogenic OR "dendritic spine" OR neuroplasticity OR "synaptic plasticity" OR "synaptic density" OR SV2A OR BDNF OR TrkB OR "critical period") AND (psychedelic OR ketamine OR antidepressant OR "5-HT2A" OR serotonin OR depression)

groups.name: receptor_pharmacology
groups.query: ("5-HT2A" OR "serotonin 2A" OR "biased agonism" OR "beta-arrestin" OR "receptor signaling" OR "receptor signalling") AND (psychedelic OR hallucinogen OR tryptamine OR antidepressant)

groups.name: tryptamine_comp_chem
groups.query: ("molecular dynamics" OR "membrane permeation" OR "membrane permeability" OR docking OR "free energy" OR photoswitch* OR "QM/MM" OR "quantum chemical") AND (tryptamine OR psychedelic OR psilocin OR DMT OR LSD OR "5-HT2A" OR serotonin)

groups.name: pharmaco_imaging_other
groups.query: (ketamine OR esketamine OR propofol OR anaesthesia OR anesthesia OR "nitrous oxide" OR cannabis OR THC OR cannabidiol OR methylphenidate OR amphetamine OR modafinil) AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR PET)

groups.name: pet_methods
groups.query: (PET OR "positron emission tomography" OR "PET-MR" OR "PET/MR") AND ("kinetic model*" OR "tracer kinetic" OR radioligand OR "test-retest" OR "injected dose" OR "low activity" OR "arterial input" OR "image-derived input" OR "reference region" OR "synaptic density" OR "UCB-J" OR SV2A OR "receptor occupancy") AND (brain OR cerebral OR neuro*)

groups.name: tms_eeg
groups.query: ("TMS-EEG" OR "TMS–EEG" OR "TMS-evoked potential*" OR "TMS evoked potential*" OR ("transcranial magnetic stimulation" AND (EEG OR electroencephalography)))

groups.name: plasticity_imaging
groups.query: (neuroplasticity OR "synaptic density" OR "LTP-like" OR "long-term potentiation" OR "visual evoked potential" OR "mismatch negativity" OR "cortical plasticity") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR PET OR MRI) AND (human OR humans OR participants OR patients)

groups.name: neuroimaging_methods
groups.query: (fMRI OR "functional MRI" OR EEG OR MEG OR PET) AND (reproducibility OR reliability OR denoising OR "preprocessing pipeline" OR "multi-echo" OR "physiological noise" OR "head motion" OR "normative model*" OR "precision functional mapping")

groups.name: comp_modelling
groups.query: ("whole-brain model" OR "whole-brain modelling" OR "whole-brain modeling" OR "neural mass" OR "neural field" OR "mean-field" OR "computational model" OR "connectome-based model") AND (EEG OR fMRI OR MEG OR PET) AND (psychedelic OR drug OR anaesthesia OR anesthesia OR ketamine OR serotonin OR "receptor density" OR psychiatric OR depression)

groups.name: dcm_wholebrain
groups.query: ("dynamic causal modelling" OR "dynamic causal modeling" OR "dynamic causal model" OR "canonical microcircuit" OR "spectral DCM" OR "neural mass model") AND (EEG OR MEG OR ERP OR "event-related" OR "resting state" OR "resting-state" OR fMRI)

groups.name: comp_psychiatry
groups.query: ("computational psychiatry" OR "predictive coding" OR "predictive processing" OR "active inference" OR "free energy principle" OR "Bayesian brain" OR "reinforcement learning model" OR "relaxed beliefs" OR REBUS)

groups.name: receptor_maps
groups.query: ("receptor density" OR "receptor map*" OR "neurotransmitter map*" OR neuromaps OR "receptor architecture" OR "gene expression" OR transcriptomic) AND (fMRI OR PET OR cortex OR cortical) AND (serotonin OR psychedelic OR drug OR pharmacolog*)

groups.name: biopsych_top
groups.pubmed: ("Biol Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Mol Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Am J Psychiatry"[ta] OR "JAMA Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Lancet Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Nat Ment Health"[ta] OR "Transl Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Biol Psychiatry Cogn Neurosci Neuroimaging"[ta] OR "Psychol Med"[ta] OR "World Psychiatry"[ta] OR "Nat Med"[ta] OR "Lancet"[ta] OR "N Engl J Med"[ta]) AND (depress* OR schizophren* OR psychosis OR bipolar OR anxiety OR PTSD OR addiction OR "substance use" OR psychiatr*)
groups.europepmc: (JOURNAL:"Biological psychiatry" OR JOURNAL:"Molecular psychiatry" OR JOURNAL:"The American journal of psychiatry" OR JOURNAL:"JAMA psychiatry" OR JOURNAL:"The lancet. Psychiatry" OR JOURNAL:"Nature mental health" OR JOURNAL:"Translational psychiatry") AND (depression OR schizophrenia OR psychosis OR bipolar OR anxiety OR PTSD OR addiction OR psychiatric)

groups.name: psychiatry_imaging
groups.query: (depression OR "major depressive" OR bipolar OR schizophrenia OR psychosis OR PTSD OR "treatment-resistant") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR PET) AND (antidepressant OR treatment OR serotonin OR plasticity OR ketamine OR "treatment response" OR biomarker)

groups.name: addiction_imaging
groups.query: (addiction OR "substance use disorder" OR "alcohol use disorder" OR "opioid use disorder" OR craving OR gambling) AND (EEG OR fMRI OR MEG OR PET OR neuroimaging)

groups.name: brain_body
groups.query: ("heartbeat evoked" OR "heartbeat-evoked" OR respiration OR breathing OR respiratory OR gastric OR electrogastrography OR EGG OR "gastric rhythm" OR "cardiac cycle" OR "heart rate variability" OR interoception OR "brain-body" OR "brain-heart" OR "gut-brain" OR "body-brain") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR "BOLD" OR "neural oscillations" OR neuroimaging)

groups.name: interoception_psych
groups.query: (interoception OR interoceptive OR "vagus nerve" OR vagal OR "autonomic" OR "heart rate variability") AND ({psychedelic_terms} OR ketamine OR depression OR anxiety OR "altered state*")

groups.name: eeg_dynamics
groups.query: (EEG OR MEG OR electroencephalography OR magnetoencephalography) AND (microstate OR microstates OR "Lempel-Ziv" OR complexity OR entropy OR criticality OR "cross-frequency" OR "hidden Markov" OR bifurcation OR "state space" OR "neural dynamics" OR metastability)

groups.name: info_theory_dynamics
groups.query: ("integrated information" OR "information theory" OR "information-theoretic" OR "information decomposition" OR synergy OR "transfer entropy" OR "higher-order interactions" OR "brain dynamics" OR "dynamical systems" OR "connectome harmonics" OR eigenmodes OR "geometric eigenmodes") AND (brain OR neural OR cortex OR EEG OR fMRI OR MEG)

groups.name: travelling_waves
groups.query: ("traveling wave" OR "travelling wave" OR "traveling waves" OR "travelling waves" OR "propagating wave" OR "cortical waves" OR "wave propagation") AND (EEG OR MEG OR ECoG OR cortex OR cortical OR "local field potential" OR fMRI)

groups.name: aperiodic_waveform
groups.query: (aperiodic OR "1/f" OR "spectral exponent" OR "spectral slope" OR FOOOF OR specparam OR bycycle OR "non-sinusoidal" OR "waveform shape" OR "oscillatory bursts") AND (EEG OR MEG OR ECoG OR "local field potential" OR oscillation*)

groups.name: consciousness_dynamics
groups.query: (consciousness OR anaesthesia OR anesthesia OR "disorders of consciousness" OR "slow waves" OR "perturbational complexity") AND (EEG OR MEG OR intracranial OR "high-density" OR fMRI)

groups.name: wider_journals
groups.pubmed: ({wider_journals_pubmed}) NOT (Editorial[pt] OR News[pt] OR Comment[pt] OR Letter[pt] OR Published Erratum[pt] OR Retraction of Publication[pt] OR Review[pt] OR Interview[pt] OR Biography[pt] OR Congress[pt])

groups.name: tools_papers
groups.query: ("open-source" OR "open source" OR toolbox OR "Python package" OR "software package" OR "BIDS app" OR "BIDS-App" OR "analysis pipeline" OR "preprocessing pipeline") AND (EEG OR MEG OR fMRI OR PET OR MRI OR neuroimaging OR "TMS-EEG")

groups.name: methods_papers
groups.pubmed: ("Neuroimage"[ta] OR "Imaging Neurosci (Camb)"[ta] OR "J Neurosci Methods"[ta] OR "Nat Methods"[ta] OR "Hum Brain Mapp"[ta] OR "Neuroinformatics"[ta] OR "J Cereb Blood Flow Metab"[ta] OR "EJNMMI Phys"[ta] OR "Brain Topogr"[ta] OR "Netw Neurosci"[ta] OR "PLoS Comput Biol"[ta] OR "Magn Reson Med"[ta] OR "J Nucl Med"[ta]) AND ("novel method" OR "new method" OR "novel approach" OR "new approach" OR framework OR "we propose" OR "we introduce" OR "we present" OR validation OR benchmark* OR "kinetic model*")

scoring._anchored_note: Profile-anchored groups (neuroscience, biological psychiatry) only keep papers from anchor_venues whose TF-IDF similarity to Claudio's profile (own papers + likes) is at least this.

keyword_negations._comment: if a keyword's match is only explained by a non-psychedelic usage, ignore it

current_analyses._comment: Extra boost when a paper matches Claudio's own current lines of work. Title hit = full, abstract hit = 0.6x.
